chars.AMINA: a young Moroccan woman in her late 20s with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a bright mustard-yellow satin blouse, gold hoop earrings and a thin gold wedding ring
chars.AHMED: a Moroccan man in his early 30s with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a light-blue office shirt with a dark-navy tie and grey trousers
chars.PAKISTANI: a Pakistani politician in his late 40s with a neat grey-streaked beard, wearing a white shalwar kameez with a black waistcoat and a big gold watch

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Modern Casablanca apartment living room. AMINA sits on the sofa secretly smiling at her smartphone, hiding the screen, while AHMED stands in the doorway behind her holding his work bag and stares at her with a suspicious, tense frown. Both faces clearly visible in the middle of the frame.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AMINA lying on a bed in a Casablanca bedroom at night, typing flirty messages on her phone with a sly, scheming smile, phone light on her face, sitting in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The PAKISTANI politician in a luxurious Dubai office with a window showing Dubai skyscrapers at dusk, leaning toward his phone on a video call, charmed and smiling, sitting in the centre of the frame.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Apartment entrance hall in Casablanca: AHMED walks out of the front door with his work bag, waving goodbye, while AMINA behind him already pulls out her phone with an eager secret smile. Both in the middle of the frame.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: AMINA standing in her Casablanca kitchen, staring at her phone with wide shocked-happy eyes and an open mouth, a pile of banknotes on the counter next to her, centred in the frame.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Cozy Moroccan living room in the evening: kind AHMED gently serves AMINA a glass of Moroccan mint tea with a warm innocent smile, while AMINA looks away guiltily with her phone face-down in her lap. Both centred in the frame.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Split composition: on the left the PAKISTANI politician on a video call holding up an open red ring box with a diamond ring, serious and determined; on the right AMINA in her Casablanca apartment frozen in shock with her hand over her mouth, her own gold wedding ring visible on her finger. Both faces in the central area.
